attributes.board_name: Delaware Board of Occupational Therapy Practice (Division of Professional Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE in health/social services related to OT and the licensee's roles. NBCOT-, DOTA- or AOTA-sponsored/approved and AOTA-approved-provider courses are automatically approved; others may get prior Board approval. Workshops, seminars, conferences and non-patient-specific in-service; online/independent learning with assessment (1 h = 1 CEU); without assessment (2 h = 1 CEU, max 12); journal reading with report (2 articles = 1 CEU); study groups and mentoring (2 h = 1 unit, max 12 each); presenting (1 h = 2 CEUs); posters (2 CEUs, max 12); adjunct teaching (1 credit hour = 6 CEUs); one CPR course per biennium; 1 semester credit = 10 CEUs. Job-related trainings (fire safety, OSHA, orientation, compliance) excluded.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prorated: 21–24 months left in the cycle 24 hours; 16–20 months 15 hours; 11–15 months 10 hours; 10 months or less exempt.
rules.audit_note: Electronic attestation at renewal; random audits after July 31 of each renewal year, verification due within 10 business days. All late renewals are audited.
rules.legal_basis: 24 Del. Admin. Code 2000, Section 3.0; 24 Del.C. ch. 20
rules.notes: Unit as the rule states it: 1 'CEU' = 60 minutes of learning, so 24 CEUs = 24 hours. CE must be completed by July 31 of each even-numbered year. Proposed amendment (Delaware Register, August 2025) would add a mandatory 2 hours in elder or child abuse each biennium; not yet in the Administrative Code text as read on the check date.
